category_definitions.direct_measurement_candidate: Declaration invokes a measured scale/assay; not necessarily numerically verified or transferable.
category_definitions.published_model_or_transferred_value: Published model or transfer across assay/species/cell/molecule/state/representation; overlaps measurement candidates.
category_definitions.derived_or_computational_relation: Construction from other inputs, formula, geometry or fit projection; not independent observation.
category_definitions.decision_or_placeholder: Preparation, PI decision, explicit initial point or stand-in.
category_definitions.numerical_or_control: Discretization, solver/resource budget, switch, seed, guard or observation design.
category_definitions.unresolved: Necessary numerical/identity/context anchor absent or ambiguous; overlaps other roles.

limitations: Manual interpretations of full declarations, not substring proof, accepted sourcing, priors or training targets.
Identity-audit OK establishes identity only; numeric support and transfer separate. Unregistered/non-OK sources stay candidate/ineligible even after primary reading.
No uncertainty/covariance invented. Reported spreads stay in focused cards with original kind or as_reported.
Not every cited paper was traced; original source declarations preserved and untested claims remain source-text-only.
Same review group/DOI is not automatically same fit. Mixed motor/catch-slip contexts separated.
Not native-run validation, inference, model adjudication or proof of one experimentally matched cell.
KB is captured mirror, not fresh Notion synchronization.

relations.statement: Assembled-object census, free/dormant pool, competent heads and occupied crossbridges are separate observables. Two-state fraction fixes object reserve, while head competence acts on assembled heads.

counted intensity focus need not universally resolve one minifilament
per-object isoform assignment is a model choice

relations.statement: Per-NPF nucleation, free-complex inventory and F-actin fluorescence contribution cannot become one free-complex rate and filament-count fraction.

Ferrer jointly fits filamin dissociation and Hummer–Szabo x‡ to rupture data. Current k_off0 shares the fitted numerical point, but the current Bell length0.4nm has no established definition mapping to fitted x‡0.194nm. No current-parameter joint distribution follows.
Mixed catch/slip cards and copied Bell lengths form provenance dependencies, not verified molecular equivalence.
Velocity/step gives effective cycle rate; velocity/koff gives run length only with constant speed and memoryless detachment.2x guard is not uncertainty.
Total pool, cargo copy number, motor arrangement, reach and effective attachment differ. Jiang shows arrangement affects transport at fixed copy number.
assumptions: synthetic liposome is not native census

relations.statement: Spoke/mesh, basal-disc/pitch and birth/lifetime count formulas are separate architectural models.
assumptions: computed count is not observed census

relations.statement: Diffusional equivalent dimensions and r^4 hydraulic conductance are distinct inference layers.
Tracer diffusion, viscosity and tension diffusion differ; porous membrane transport ties viscosity, obstacle permeability and modulus.
Funk growth fit and Courtemanche end-affinity fits differ; shared DOI or copied equality is not covariance.
Reserve fractions are capacities sized against flux and duration, not measured abundance fractions.
Whole-nucleus response, shell scaling, network shear and tension require separate carrier/geometry projections.

parameters.name: actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. parameters.name: crosslink.molecular_model

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

parameters.name: envelope.mu_2d

declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

parameters.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

parameters.name: microtubule.dimer_rise

declaration.source: the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. parameters.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

parameters.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.
